request.description: Imports every active level-8 street from GAR objects and administrative hierarchy, including streets without houses. City is always Москва. Stores full_address, locality and hierarchy_path to distinguish same-named streets. No body; no 1000-row limit. Existing GUIDs are refreshed when values change; unchanged rows are skipped. Returns inserted, updated and total.

item.name: Add up to 1000 new random addresses

request.description: Reads local GAR XML, then atomically adds up to 1000 new addresses. Existing house GUIDs are skipped and stored rows stay unchanged. No request body. May take several minutes.

exec: pm.test('Import counters are consistent', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const r = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(r.requested).to.eql(1000); pm.expect(r.imported).to.be.within(0, 1000); pm.expect(r.exhausted).to.eql(r.imported < r.requested); pm.expect(r.total).to.be.at.least(r.imported); });

request.description: Deletes every row in the address table.

Returns 202 immediately. Samples up to 20 streets whose repair data was not loaded yet (streets with repair_data_loaded=true are skipped) and imports every page in the background. A street is marked as loaded only after all of its pages are fetched successfully, so failed streets are retried on the next run. Conflicting import/clear returns 409.
Task timestamps, state, selected streets, saved page/item counters and detailed errors.

item.name: Delete capital repair data and ALL job history

request.description: Deletes all repair data, source pages and job history. Preserves streets and addresses, including the streets.repair_data_loaded flag: already loaded streets stay skipped by the next import. Returns 204, or 409 during an active import.

Returns 202 immediately. Samples up to 50 repair houses whose program_name starts with "Региональная" and whose detail was not loaded yet, then GETs each /objects/rpkr/{houseGuid} with a 1–3 s delay. Raw payload and searchable work rows are stored; the house is marked loaded only after full success. Conflicting import/clear returns 409.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 202) { const jobId = pm.response.json().jobId; pm.collectionVariables.set('programJobId', jobId); pm.test('Location header points to the job', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Location')).to.eql('/api/program-imports/' + jobId); }); }

request.description: Selected houses, timestamps, success/failure counters, saved works and error details.

exec: pm.test('Job status is reported', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const r = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(r.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('programJobId')); pm.expect(['QUEUED','RUNNING','PARTIAL_FAILED','SUCCESS','FAILED','INTERRUPTED']).to.include(r.status); });

item.name: Delete program data and ALL job history

request.description: Deletes program houses, works and job history. Keeps repair_houses.program_data_loaded flags, so loaded houses stay skipped by the next import. Returns 204, or 409 during an active import.

exec: pm.test('Program data cleared', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(204); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql(''); });
